description: US entry-percentile software wage sets a new real decade low (5% below the decade floor)
target_derivation: Decade-boundary threshold, not unit economics: the real (2025 USD) window minimum for BLS OEWS P25 software-developer pay is 101730 (2018); 96000 = 5.6% below it (exact 5% = 96644; 96000 kept as the conservative round number). Crossing means entry pay broke below everything seen since 2016.
